name: Exp_TimesDirection
summary: This EA trades based on time-of-day directional signals, analyzing price movement direction during specific time windows to determine trade entries. It opens positions when the market direction aligns with historically favorable time-based patterns, typically operating during sessions where directional bias is strongest.
summary_zh: 该EA基于时段方向信号进行交易，分析特定时间窗口内的价格运动方向来确定入场时机。当市场方向与历史上有利的时间模式一致时开仓，通常在方向性偏差最强的时段操作。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于时间序列方向分析，即特定交易时段内价格运动具有统计上的方向偏好。入场条件为当前价格方向与指定时间窗口内的趋势方向一致时开仓，可能结合多个时间框架的方向确认来增强信号可靠性。出场条件包括固定止盈止损、方向反转信号或时段结束时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位方式。资金管理方面未发现复杂的动态调整机制，主要依赖固定参数控制风险敞口。整体策略属于基于时间规律的系统性交易方法，假设某些时段存在可预测的方向性运动。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on time-series directional analysis, assuming that price movement during specific trading sessions exhibits statistically significant directional bias. Entry conditions trigger when the current price direction aligns with the trend direction within a defined time window, potentially combining multi-timeframe directional confirmation to enhance signal reliability. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, directional reversal signals, or position closure at the end of the designated time session. Position sizing employs fixed lot sizes or account-balance-proportional sizing methods. Money management does not appear to incorporate sophisticated dynamic adjustment mechanisms, primarily relying on fixed parameters to control risk exposure. The overall strategy falls under systematic time-based trading, assuming certain sessions exhibit predictable directional movement patterns.

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit distance in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: Timeframe
parameters.description: 方向判断所用时间周期

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying managed positions

pros: 时间过滤机制可避免低流动性时段交易，减少滑点和虚假信号
基于时段方向偏好的策略具有统计理论基础，某些时段确实存在方向性规律
系统化交易逻辑清晰，参数可调，便于回测和优化
多周期方向确认可提高信号质量和胜率
pros_en: Time filtering mechanism avoids trading during low liquidity sessions, reducing slippage and false signals
Session-based directional bias strategy has statistical theoretical foundation, as certain periods do exhibit directional patterns
Systematic trading logic is clear with adjustable parameters, facilitating backtesting and optimization
Multi-timeframe directional confirmation can improve signal quality and win rate
cons: 过度依赖历史时段规律，市场结构变化时策略可能失效
固定止盈止损未考虑市场波动率变化，在不同波动环境下表现不稳定
缺乏动态资金管理机制，无法根据账户权益变化调整仓位
时段参数优化容易导致过拟合，实盘表现可能偏离回测结果
未考虑点差和手续费对短线时段交易的影响
cons_en: Over-reliance on historical session patterns; strategy may fail when market structure changes
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit don't account for volatility changes, leading to inconsistent performance across varying volatility environments
Lack of dynamic money management mechanism prevents position adjustment based on account equity changes
Time window parameter optimization is prone to overfitting, and live performance may deviate from backtest results
Does not account for spread and commission impacts on short-duration session trades
improvements: 引入自适应时段识别机制，根据近期波动率动态调整交易时间窗口
增加动态止损机制（如ATR止损），根据市场波动率调整止损距离
添加点差过滤和资金管理模块，根据账户权益动态调整仓位大小
improvements_en: Introduce adaptive session identification that dynamically adjusts trading time windows based on recent volatility
Add dynamic stop-loss mechanisms (e.g., ATR-based stops) that adjust stop distances according to market volatility
Implement spread filter and money management module that dynamically adjusts position sizing based on account equity

risk_points: 固定止损可能在剧烈波动时不足以及时止损，造成超出预期的亏损
时段策略在市场结构转变时可能连续亏损，缺乏自适应机制
未检测到明确的持仓检查和重复开仓防护机制
risk_points_en: Fixed stop-loss may be insufficient during extreme volatility, causing losses beyond expectations
Session-based strategy may incur consecutive losses during market structure shifts, lacking adaptive mechanisms
No explicit position check or duplicate order prevention mechanism detected
